verdict.rationale: GitLab docs confirm security/code quality findings (SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, DAST) surface directly in merge requests, supporting review of third-party quality reports in the review screen, but there is no evidence about large-diff handling/viewing UX or performance for large diffs, and no independent corroboration of the review-screen integration experience. missing for 10: evidence on large-diff rendering/performance in MR view, independent/hands-on confirmation of code quality reports appearing inline, detail on which specific third-party report types are supported.
